gaps.title: Unexplored Application of Knowledge Graph on And Dataset
gaps.description: While Knowledge Graph and And Dataset are prominent in current literature, zero papers in the corpus have evaluated Knowledge Graph directly on And Dataset under Adversarial Data-Poisoning Attacks constraints.
gaps.hypothesis: Applying Knowledge Graph directly to And Dataset under Adversarial Data-Poisoning Attacks constraints will overcome the structural representation disconnect, achieving statistically significant error reduction over traditional baseline heuristics.
